scientific_source.role: completed acquisition and governed scientific source; read-only

evidence_boundaries.address_actor: Addresses are protocol identifiers, not verified natural persons or independent economic actors.
evidence_boundaries.hhi_construct: Pool-event-frequency HHI is not capital, liquidity, ownership, risk, welfare, or governance power.
evidence_boundaries.hhi_aggregation: Mean-weekly and pooled-period HHI changes are different nonlinear aggregations and are not interchangeable.
evidence_boundaries.simulation: Simulation outputs are synthetic and uncalibrated.
evidence_boundaries.causal: Arbitrum-Gnosis estimates are failed-design diagnostics, not a treatment effect.
evidence_boundaries.infrastructure: Verified route-level infrastructure dependence remains blocked.
